name: index
title: EQL Source public data
description: Versioned, per-claim-sourced EverQuest Legends data, free to consume. Nobody else in this community publishes any, so we do.

terms.summary: Use it, credit EQL Source, and read the provenance before you trust a value.
terms.measured: The measured data — drop sightings, damage figures, spell lists — is parsed from this project's own combat logs. Freely usable with attribution.
terms.inherited: Fields sourced from community wikis carry their tier and source. Those values are not ours to license; respect the original source and do not present a tier 5 figure as fact.
terms.warranty: None. This is a fan project and the game is actively patched. Every dataset here states what it does not know.
terms.unofficial: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Daybreak Game Company, Game Jawn or Darkpaw Studios.

stability: Fields in a vN file are never removed and never change type.
New optional fields may be added; ignore keys you do not recognise.
A breaking change gets a new version at a new URL. The old one stays up.
Values change as evidence improves. That is the product working, not a breach — watch `hash` if you cache.

datasets.name: sky
datasets.title: Plane of Sky class unlock quests
datasets.description: Every Plane of Sky test for all sixteen classes, with the turn-ins, the island each component drops on, and a source recorded per claim.

datasets.name: sightings
datasets.title: Measured drop sources
datasets.description: Which mobs have been measured dropping which items, parsed from combat logs. Each row carries the sighting count behind it.

datasets.name: zones
datasets.title: Surveyed dungeons
datasets.description: The zones we have surveyed, with the level band, the experience modifier and how far verification has got.
